parts.t: Amazing opportunity awaits in Walnut Grove! This one-of-a-kind 2048 SQFT, 3-bedroom, 4-bath, duplex-style townhouse is located in Creekside Estates. It boasts Brazilian Cherrywood floors that extend throughout the home, a renovated kitchen, a renovated powder room, and a fully finished basement that offers ample comfortable space. Step outside onto an expansive patio surrounded by lush greenery, creating a tranquil outdoor retreat. Nestled in Walnut Grove, this home perfectly balances serenity and convenience, with schools and shopping nearby. A fourth Bedroom can easily be added on the lower level!
